entries.name: Kiwi TCMS
entries.summary: 开源测试管理系统，管理测试用例、测试计划与针对构建的测试执行，并记录逐项执行结果。

leaf_matches.reason: README 与官方用户指南显示：测试用例是与测试计划关联的可复用受管记录（含步骤与可测量预期结果），测试运行针对特定产品构建实例化选定的已确认用例，执行时由测试人员逐项记录状态与备注；对应测试用例库、测试运行/判定、受管测试工作三结构。

features: README: open source test management system for manual and automated testing; bug tracker integration, search pages, access control, test automation framework plugins, visual reports and a rich API.

docs testcase.rst: test cases carry setup instructions, actions and measurable expected results; cases are associated with test plans; only CONFIRMED cases can be added to a test run; peer review workflow.

docs testrun.rst: a Test Run contains execution results of selected test cases against particular product builds; it is created for a test plan, assigned to a tester, and each case execution records a status and comment.
deployment: README: Docker container installation documented; a public tenant is also available. 本轮未运行或部署。

entries.name: OpenSTF
entries.summary: 开源 Android 设备农场 Web 应用，自托管设备目录并提供浏览器内远程控制、APK 安装与设备日志查看。

leaf_matches.reason: README 的功能清单显示其维护可搜索的设备目录（设备库存、分组、预订/分区），并允许用户在浏览器中实时远程控制选定 Android 设备、安装并启动 APK、查看设备日志；这对应“设备目录 + 按需可观察的交互式执行”。README 未展示自动化测试编排能力，故仅按交互式设备会话匹配，不声称自动化执行。

features: README: STF is a web application for debugging smartphones, smartwatches and other gadgets remotely, from the browser.
README: remote control any device from your browser with real-time screen view, typing, multitouch, drag-and-drop .apk install/launch, device logs, and adb connect.
README: monitor device inventory; search devices by model, OS, operator and other attributes; booking and partitioning; simple REST API.
deployment: README: self-hosted Node.js 8.x deployment with ADB, RethinkDB, GraphicsMagick, ZeroMQ and Protocol Buffers; Docker/NPM distribution. 本轮未运行或部署。
README top warning: the community project is provided as-is without active development; active development moved to DeviceFarmer (repository last push 2023-05-31).

license_review.rationale: GitHub 许可证 API 返回 NOASSERTION，已核对仓库 LICENSE 完整文本为 Apache License 2.0。

entries.name: Playwright
entries.summary: 开源端到端测试运行器/框架（Playwright Test），通过真实浏览器界面执行持久化测试，并输出逐项判定与失败追踪。

leaf_matches.reason: README 明确 Playwright Test 是面向端到端测试的完整测试运行器：测试作为持久化脚本表达导航、界面交互与断言，可对真实应用在 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit 上自动执行，并产生逐测试结果以及失败时的 trace、截图和视频；对应“整体应用经真实界面执行 + 持久测试资产 + 逐项判定与故障证据”。它是开源开发工具/运行器，并非厂商托管服务，匹配限定于此。

features: README: Playwright Test is a full-featured test runner built for end-to-end testing; it runs tests across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with browser isolation, auto-waiting and web-first assertions.
README: tests are persistent scripts using test/expect; `npx playwright test` runs them in parallel, headless by default, and each test gets a fresh browser context.
README: tracing captures execution traces, screenshots and videos on failure; Trace Viewer inspects actions, DOM snapshots, network requests and console messages.
deployment: README: install via npm (`npm init playwright@latest` or `npm i -D @playwright/test`) and run locally or in CI; headless by default. 本轮未运行或部署。

entries.name: k6
entries.summary: 开源负载测试工具，用脚本定义模拟用户场景，按 VU/阶段施加可控负载并测量吞吐、延迟与错误。

leaf_matches.reason: README 的示例与功能说明显示：k6 脚本是持久可重跑的场景（HTTP 请求与 check 断言），options.stages 定义 VU 数量及升降持续时间，options.thresholds 定义性能阈值，运行后输出请求时长等指标；对应负载场景、受控模拟群体、执行与测量三要素。CLI 可本地、CI 或 Kubernetes 运行，非厂商托管服务。
同一 k6 条目复用：README 以“Like unit testing, for performance”定位，stages/thresholds/scenarios 的同一结构可塑造成负载、压力、峰值等性能测试形态；对应性能测试应用所要求的场景、模拟群体与测量结果。Grafana Cloud 商业 SaaS 不计入本条目断言。

features: README: modern load-testing tool with configurable load generation, tests as code, an embedded JavaScript engine, and multiple protocol support.
README example: `options.thresholds` asserts p(99) < 3000ms; `options.stages` ramps VUs 0→15→0; the default function sends HTTP requests and runs `check` assertions.
README: scenarios support open and closed models, constant RPS and fixed iterations; results output exposes metrics; Grafana Cloud is an optional commercial SaaS integration.
deployment: README: run scripts via the CLI locally, in CI, or across a Kubernetes cluster; 本轮未运行或部署。

license_review.rationale: GitHub 许可证 API 返回 spdx_id AGPL-3.0，已核对仓库 LICENSE 完整文本为 GNU Affero General Public License v3。
